mentions.name: Kuvo
mentions.description: A Python tool that builds distroless container images for projects managed by the uv package manager, inspired by Ko from the Go ecosystem. It is an early-stage hobby project that technically works but lacks several features, such as the ability to target platforms compatible with the distroless uv container image.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a Python tool to build distroless container images for projects managed by uv. It draws inspiration from Ko from the Go ecosystem and works with/depends on uv from the Python ecosystem, so I smashed them together and called it Kuvo: https://github.com/hxtk/kuvo
